name: gitEnglish Hub
prompt_hint: Use a dark, premium editorial theme. Background `#0f1112`, card background `#16181a` (or `rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.3)`), accent color `#ff6b35` (burnt mandarin), secondary text `#9ca3af`, primary text `#e5e7eb`, border `#3f3f46`. Typography: Body uses system-ui. Headings MUST use 'Raleway' font, weight 800 (black), and uppercase. Do NOT use tight letter-spacing or negative word-spacing; keep the spacing readable. ACCENT GRADIENT: Use a subtle gradient from burnt mandarin (#ff6b35) to burnt blood (#8a1c00) for structural accents like thin left-borders on cards (3-4px), subtle dividers under section headers. Layout Elements: Use a `.summary-box` class with a thin border and an absolutely positioned top-left `.summary-label` (uppercase, monospace, accent color). Use `.card` classes with the gradient left-border and flat backgrounds. All CSS must be inline in a single <style> tag. ICONS: Add these explicit CSS rules for SVG icons to make them large and premium: `svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke-width: 2px; color: #ff6b35; margin-right: 12px; vertical-align: middle; }`. Do NOT use basic emojis, use clean, professional inline SVGs (like Lucide style) and apply the SVG sizing CSS.
print_css: @media print { body { background: #fff !important; color: #333 !important; } .ge-card, .card, .summary-box { background: #f9f9f9 !important; border: 1px solid #ccc !important; box-shadow: none !important; } .ge-accent, svg { color: #cc5500 !important; } button[id='regenerate'] { display: none !important; } @page { margin: 1.5cm; size: A4; break-inside: avoid; } }
